fields.label: Check Interval Sec
fields.help: How often (in seconds) to send a health check.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: An optional description of this resource.

fields.label: Healthy Threshold
fields.help: A so-far unhealthy instance will be marked healthy after this many consecutive successes.

fields.label: Host
fields.help: The value of the host header in the HTTPS health check request.

fields.label: Port
fields.help: The TCP port number for the HTTPS health check request.

fields.label: Request Path
fields.help: The request path of the HTTPS health check request.

fields.label: Timeout Sec
fields.help: How long (in seconds) to wait before claiming failure.

fields.label: Unhealthy Threshold
fields.help: A so-far healthy instance will be marked unhealthy after this many consecutive failures.
